source_title: OKX will list Raydium’s RAY token for spot trading

spot_trading_start.statement: OKX's listing announcement states that RAY/USDT spot trading was scheduled to open at 10:00 UTC on 2021-12-17.

limitations: This record authenticates the project's source check, not an immutable copy of the third-party webpage.
The current OKX instruments API reports an earlier listTime, which is not substituted for the announcement's explicit spot-opening time.
The API and announcement are surfaces of the same exchange, so evidence_status remains primary_confirmed rather than cross_checked.
